title: Debris-blocked shafts between Khafre and the Sphinx connect to underground facilities
place_text: Giza Plateau between Khafre pyramid and Sphinx, Egypt

tellings.quote: um according to our scouts, we are confident, very confident that those shafts shafts are connected to the under ground facilities that are located below Giza.

plain: Shafts in the ground between the pyramid of Khafre, one of the great pyramids at Giza in Egypt, and the Sphinx are blocked with rubble but lead down to large underground structures beneath Giza, according to Filippo Biondi, a scientist who scanned beneath the pyramids. Biondi says that based on his team's scans they are very confident the shafts are connected to these underground facilities. If true, it would mean there is a hidden world of chambers under the plateau.
